name: Mitch Markowitz
bio_short: Mitch Markowitz is one of eight participants in Unframed at Holland Tunnel Revisited in Newburgh, a group that has met weekly for three years to paint outdoors together.
bio_long: Mitch Markowitz took part in Unframed (September 12 to October 11, 2026) at Holland Tunnel Revisited, 46 Chambers Street, Newburgh. The participants come from different backgrounds and meet weekly, year-round, to spend a few hours painting together; the works in the show were made during those gatherings over about three years. Markowitz exhibited with Tom Benson, Paul Chidester, Emily Hopkins, Nancy Manter, Michelle Marozik, Kendall Munk and Itty Neuhaus. Further biographical details have not yet been confirmed and will be added once supplied by the artist or the gallery.
practice: Participates in a weekly group painting practice; works in the exhibition were made during these gatherings.
